```yaml
name: Upgrade Check

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Ruby
      uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
      with:
        ruby-version: '3.1'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: bundle install --path vendor/bundle

    - name: Add al_cookie to Gemfile
      run: echo "gem 'al_cookie'" >> Gemfile

    - name: Update distill configuration
      run: sed -i 's/al_folio.distill.allow_remote_loader: false/al_folio.distill.allow_remote_loader: true/' config/_config.yml

    - name: Run Prettier lint
      run: npm run lint:prettier

    - name: Run Style Contract lint
      run: npm run lint:style-contract

    - name: Run Integration Bootstrap Compatibility Tests
      run: bash test/integration_bootstrap_compat.sh

    - name: Run Integration Distill Tests
      run: bash test/integration_distill.sh

    - name: Run Integration Upgrade CLI Tests
      run: bash test/integration_upgrade_cli.sh

    - name: Setup Python for Jupyter deps
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: '3.9'
        cache: 'true'

    - name: Install Python dependencies
      run: pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run Python setup helper
      run: ./bin/setup-python-deps

    - name: Notify Slack on Workflow Status
      uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
      with:
        webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        status: ${{ job.status }}
        channel: '#devops-notifications'
        message: 'Upgrade Check Workflow has completed with status: ${{ job.status }}'
```
